words.exampleCn: 一次简短的讨论解决了争议。

words.cn: 限制
words.example: The gate restricts access after dark.
words.exampleCn: 天黑后大门限制通行。

words.cn: 维持
words.example: It is hard to sustain that pace for an hour.
words.exampleCn: 维持那个速度一小时并不容易。

words.cn: 废除
words.example: The council voted to abolish the fee for library cards.
words.exampleCn: 市议会投票决定取消借书证的办卡费。

words.cn: 加快
words.example: Shared deliveries could accelerate the rollout of the new service.
words.exampleCn: 联合配送可能加快这项新服务的推广。

words.cn: 容纳
words.example: The studio can accommodate ten dancers at a time.
words.exampleCn: 舞蹈室一次可容纳十名舞者。

words.cn: 积聚
words.example: Fine dust gradually accumulates behind the cabinet.
words.exampleCn: 细灰慢慢积在柜子后面。

words.cn: 承认
words.example: The report acknowledges that some households were missed.
words.exampleCn: 报告承认调查遗漏了一些家庭。

words.cn: 不利的
words.example: Adverse winds delayed the survey boat by a day.
words.exampleCn: 不利的风向让测量船耽搁了一天。

words.cn: 缓解
words.example: A second entrance could alleviate crowding after concerts.
words.exampleCn: 增设一个入口可缓解音乐会结束后的拥挤。

words.cn: 修订
words.example: The trustees amended the policy to cover evening classes.
words.exampleCn: 受托人修订了政策，使其适用于夜间课程。

words.cn: 任意的
words.example: The cut-off date looked arbitrary until we saw the harvest records.
words.exampleCn: 看到收成记录之前，那个截止日期看起来是随意定的。

words.cn: 断言
words.example: The editor asserts that the two letters were written years apart.
words.exampleCn: 编辑断言这两封信的写作时间相隔数年。

words.cn: 达到
words.example: The kiln must attain a steady temperature before firing begins.
words.exampleCn: 正式烧制前，窑炉必须达到并保持稳定的温度。

words.cn: 真实的
words.example: A dated photograph helped establish that the sign was authentic.
words.exampleCn: 一张注明日期的照片帮助证实了这块标牌的真实性。

words.cn: 自主权
words.example: Branch managers have some autonomy over opening hours.
words.exampleCn: 分店经理有一定的营业时间决定权。

words.cn: 能胜任的
words.example: A competent guide knows when to turn the group back.
words.exampleCn: 称职的向导知道何时该带队折返。

words.cn: 补充；与……相辅相成
words.example: The interviews complement the figures in the annual report.
words.exampleCn: 访谈补充了年报里的数据。

words.cn: 承认；让步
words.example: The designer conceded that the ramp was too steep.
words.exampleCn: 设计师承认坡道太陡了。

words.cn: 连续的
words.example: The pond froze on three consecutive nights.
words.exampleCn: 池塘连续三个晚上都结了冰。

words.cn: 节约
words.example: The school collects rainwater to conserve drinking water.
words.exampleCn: 学校收集雨水来节约饮用水。

words.cn: 咨询
words.example: The architect consulted residents before moving the main entrance.
words.exampleCn: 建筑师在迁移主入口之前征询了居民意见。

words.cn: 与……相矛盾
words.example: The first receipt contradicts the date in the diary.
words.exampleCn: 第一张收据上的日期与日记里的日期不符。

words.cn: 传达
words.example: A longer pause can convey doubt without a single word.
words.exampleCn: 稍长的停顿无需言语就能传达犹豫。

words.cn: 可信的
words.example: The technician gave a credible account of the failure.
words.exampleCn: 技术员对故障作出了可信的说明。

words.cn: 抑制
words.example: The café serves smaller portions to curb waste.
words.exampleCn: 咖啡馆供应小份餐食来减少浪费。

words.cn: 推迟
words.example: We deferred the inspection until the tide went out.
words.exampleCn: 我们把检查推迟到了退潮后。

words.cn: 故意的；有意的
words.example: Leaving the last shelf empty was a deliberate choice.
words.exampleCn: 空出最后一层架子是有意为之。

words.cn: 诊断；查明
words.example: The mechanic used a pressure gauge to diagnose the fault.
words.exampleCn: 修理工用压力表查明了故障。

words.cn: 披露
words.example: The panel disclosed the criteria before scoring the entries.
words.exampleCn: 评审小组在给参赛作品打分前公布了标准。

words.cn: 扰乱；中断
words.example: A power cut disrupted the first rehearsal.
words.exampleCn: 停电打断了第一次排练。

words.cn: 有资格的
words.example: Part-time students are eligible for the travel discount.
words.exampleCn: 非全日制学生有资格享受交通折扣。

words.cn: 认可；支持
words.example: The union endorsed the proposal for paid training.
words.exampleCn: 工会支持带薪培训的提议。

words.cn: 执行
words.example: It is easier to enforce the rule when the signs are clear.
words.exampleCn: 标志清楚时，这条规定更容易执行。

words.cn: 可行的
words.example: An outdoor screening is feasible if we can borrow a generator.
words.exampleCn: 如果能借到发电机，露天放映就可行。

words.cn: 制定；表述
words.example: After hearing both accounts, she formulated a clearer question.
words.exampleCn: 听完双方的说法，她提出了一个更清楚的问题。

words.cn: 强制实行
words.example: The club imposed a time limit on practice sessions.
words.exampleCn: 俱乐部给训练时段设定了时限。

words.cn: 保留
words.example: The renovation retained the building's original stair rail.
words.exampleCn: 整修工程保留了楼里原来的楼梯扶手。

words.cn: 取回
words.example: A caretaker retrieved the ball from the empty fountain.
words.exampleCn: 管理员从干涸的喷泉池里取回了球。

words.cn: 严谨的
words.example: The workshop applies a rigorous checklist before shipping each instrument.
words.exampleCn: 作坊在发运每件仪器前都按严格的清单逐项检查。

words.cn: 细微的
words.example: The two glazes show a subtle difference in daylight.
words.exampleCn: 这两种釉料在日光下显出细微差异。

words.cn: 削弱
words.example: Changing the rules halfway through could undermine trust in the contest.
words.exampleCn: 比赛中途改规则可能削弱人们对赛事的信任。

words.cn: 可行的；能持续的
words.example: A shared kiln made the pottery studio financially viable.
words.exampleCn: 共用窑炉使陶艺工作室在财务上得以维持。

name: IELTS 学术
description: 熟悉学术阅读、图表描述和论证中的常见用词。

words.cn: 抽象的
words.example: The teacher used a model to explain an abstract idea.
words.exampleCn: 老师用模型解释了一个抽象概念。

words.cn: 总计的
words.example: The report compares aggregate income across regions.
words.exampleCn: 报告比较了各地区的总收入。

words.cn: 分配
words.example: The board allocated funds to the research team.
words.exampleCn: 董事会给研究团队分配了经费。

words.cn: 分析
words.example: The researchers analysed samples from three rivers.
words.exampleCn: 研究人员分析了来自三条河流的样品。

words.cn: 异常现象
words.example: One unusual reading appeared to be an anomaly.
words.exampleCn: 一个不寻常的读数似乎是异常值。

words.cn: 把……归因于
words.example: They attributed the fall in demand to higher prices.
words.exampleCn: 他们把需求下降归因于价格上涨。

words.cn: 偏差
words.example: A wider survey might reduce sampling bias.
words.exampleCn: 扩大调查范围或许能降低抽样偏差。

words.cn: 类别
words.example: Each response belongs to a separate category.
words.exampleCn: 每条回答属于不同的类别。

words.cn: 引用
words.example: The author cites several historical sources.
words.exampleCn: 作者引用了几份历史资料。

words.cn: 分类
words.example: Biologists classify the species by its physical features.
words.exampleCn: 生物学家按照身体特征对该物种进行分类。

words.cn: 汇编
words.example: She compiled a list of relevant studies.
words.exampleCn: 她汇编了一份相关研究清单。

words.cn: 由……组成
words.example: The sample comprises forty households.
words.exampleCn: 样本由四十户家庭组成。

words.cn: 构想
words.example: The architect conceived the building as an open space.
words.exampleCn: 建筑师将该建筑构想为开放空间。

words.cn: 限制因素
words.example: Space is the main constraint on further expansion.
words.exampleCn: 空间是进一步扩张的主要限制因素。

words.cn: 语境
words.example: The word has a different meaning in this context.
words.exampleCn: 这个词在这个语境中有不同的含义。

words.cn: 标准
words.example: Cost was the main criterion for selection.
words.exampleCn: 成本是筛选的主要标准。

words.cn: 数据
words.example: The team collected data over six months.
words.exampleCn: 团队花了六个月收集数据。

words.cn: 赤字
words.example: A tax increase may reduce the budget deficit.
words.exampleCn: 提高税收或许能减少预算赤字。

words.cn: 定义
words.example: The paper defines risk in terms of expected loss.
words.exampleCn: 该论文以预期损失来定义风险。

words.cn: 方面
words.example: The policy has an ethical dimension.
words.exampleCn: 这项政策涉及伦理层面。

words.cn: 独立的
words.example: The work can be divided into three discrete stages.
words.exampleCn: 这项工作可以划分为三个独立阶段。

words.cn: 使迁离
words.example: The flood displaced hundreds of families.
words.exampleCn: 洪水迫使数百户家庭离开家园。

words.cn: 分布
words.example: The map shows the distribution of the species.
words.exampleCn: 地图显示了该物种的分布。

words.cn: 领域
words.example: Her work covers several domains of public policy.
words.exampleCn: 她的工作涉及公共政策的多个领域。

words.cn: 不断变化的
words.example: The model treats behaviour as a dynamic process.
words.exampleCn: 这个模型将行为视为不断变化的过程。

words.cn: 要素
words.example: Trust is a key element of successful cooperation.
words.exampleCn: 信任是成功合作的关键要素。

words.cn: 实证的
words.example: The claim requires stronger empirical evidence.
words.exampleCn: 这一论点需要更有力的实证证据。

words.cn: 等同的
words.example: The two tests are roughly equivalent in difficulty.
words.exampleCn: 两项测试的难度大致相同。

words.cn: 评价
words.example: The team evaluated the new recycling scheme.
words.exampleCn: 团队评估了新的回收方案。

words.cn: 证据
words.example: The researchers found evidence of earlier settlement.
words.exampleCn: 研究人员发现了更早有人定居的证据。

words.cn: 支出
words.example: Public expenditure on housing increased last year.
words.exampleCn: 去年的公共住房支出有所增加。

words.cn: 提取
words.example: The machine extracts oil from the seeds.
words.exampleCn: 这台机器从种子里提取油。

words.cn: 因素
words.example: Distance was only one factor in the decision.
words.exampleCn: 距离只是作出决定的因素之一。

words.cn: 波动
words.example: Food prices fluctuate throughout the year.
words.exampleCn: 食品价格全年都有波动。

words.cn: 框架
words.example: The article proposes a framework for comparing policies.
words.exampleCn: 文章提出了比较政策的框架。

words.cn: 假设
words.example: A second experiment tested the hypothesis.
words.exampleCn: 第二个实验检验了这个假设。

words.cn: 表明
words.example: Recent figures indicate a fall in demand.
words.exampleCn: 最近的数据显示需求有所下降。

words.cn: 推断
words.example: From the tracks, we can infer that a deer passed by.
words.exampleCn: 从足迹可以推断有一只鹿经过。

words.cn: 整合
words.example: The course integrates theory with practical work.
words.exampleCn: 这门课将理论与实践结合起来。

words.cn: 解读
words.example: Several experts interpreted the results differently.
words.exampleCn: 几位专家对结果的解读不同。

words.cn: 间隔
words.example: Samples were taken at regular intervals.
words.exampleCn: 每隔固定时间取一次样。

words.cn: 调查
words.example: The study investigates the causes of sleep loss.
words.exampleCn: 该研究调查了睡眠不足的原因。

words.cn: 研究方法
words.example: The report explains its methodology in detail.
words.exampleCn: 报告详细解释了所用的研究方法。

words.cn: 修改
words.example: The researchers modified the design after the pilot study.
words.exampleCn: 研究人员在试点研究后修改了设计。

words.cn: 取得
words.example: The team obtained consent from each participant.
words.exampleCn: 团队得到了每位参与者的同意。

words.cn: 参数
words.example: Temperature is a key parameter in the model.
words.exampleCn: 温度是模型中的关键参数。

words.cn: 现象
words.example: Scientists observed the same phenomenon in another species.
words.exampleCn: 科学家在另一物种中观察到了同样的现象。

words.cn: 初步的
words.example: The preliminary results show a small improvement.
words.exampleCn: 初步结果显示略有改善。

words.cn: 比例
words.example: The proportion of older residents has risen.
words.exampleCn: 老年居民的比例上升了。

words.cn: 定性的
words.example: The interviews provided qualitative information.
words.exampleCn: 访谈提供了定性信息。

words.cn: 定量的
words.example: Quantitative measures include weight and height.
words.exampleCn: 定量指标包括体重和身高。

words.cn: 比率
words.example: The ratio of teachers to pupils improved.
words.exampleCn: 教师与学生的比率有所改善。

words.cn: 恢复
words.example: The ecosystem took decades to recover.
words.exampleCn: 这个生态系统花了几十年才恢复。

words.cn: 复现
words.example: An independent team tried to replicate the experiment.
words.exampleCn: 一个独立团队尝试复现该实验。

words.cn: 范围
words.example: The project grew in scope after the first review.
words.exampleCn: 首次评审后，项目范围扩大了。

words.cn: 模拟
words.example: The models simulate weather conditions at sea.
words.exampleCn: 这些模型模拟海上的气象条件。

words.cn: 统计数据
words.example: That statistic comes from a national survey.
words.exampleCn: 那项统计数据来自全国调查。

words.cn: 随后的
words.example: Subsequent studies confirmed the finding.
words.exampleCn: 随后的研究证实了这一发现。

words.cn: 趋势
words.example: The chart shows a downward trend in water use.
words.exampleCn: 图表显示用水量呈下降趋势。

words.cn: 变量
words.example: Age was included as a variable in the analysis.
words.exampleCn: 年龄被纳入分析，作为一个变量。

words.cn: 大量；充足
words.example: The abundance of shells suggests that the site was once underwater.
words.exampleCn: 大量贝壳表明这一地点曾被水淹没。

words.cn: 相邻的
words.example: Researchers sampled soil from two adjacent fields.
words.exampleCn: 研究人员从两块相邻田地采集了土样。

words.cn: 施行；组织实施
words.example: Trained staff administered the survey by phone.
words.exampleCn: 受过培训的工作人员通过电话开展了调查。

words.cn: 对齐；成一直线
words.example: Check the alignment of the marks before taking a reading.
words.exampleCn: 读数前检查各标记是否对齐。

words.cn: 类比
words.example: The lecturer drew an analogy between a queue and a buffer.
words.exampleCn: 讲师把队列和缓冲区作了类比。

words.cn: 档案馆；档案
words.example: The city archive holds maps drawn before the harbour was built.
words.exampleCn: 市档案馆保存着港口建成以前绘制的地图。

words.cn: 基准
words.example: The first month of records provided a baseline for comparison.
words.exampleCn: 首月的记录为比较提供了基准。

words.cn: 容量
words.example: The tank has a capacity of six hundred litres.
words.exampleCn: 这个储罐的容量为六百升。

words.cn: 因果的
words.example: The figures alone cannot establish a causal link.
words.exampleCn: 单凭这些数字无法确定因果关系。

words.cn: 时间顺序
words.example: Two dated letters helped establish the chronology of the dispute.
words.exampleCn: 两封注明日期的信帮助确定了争端的时间顺序。

words.cn: 同时发生
words.example: The peak in demand coincided with a spell of cold weather.
words.exampleCn: 需求峰值恰好出现在一段寒冷天气期间。

words.cn: 组成部分
words.example: Each component can be repaired separately.
words.exampleCn: 各个部件都可以单独维修。

words.cn: 压缩
words.example: The program compresses images before storing them.
words.exampleCn: 该程序在保存图像前会先压缩图像。

words.cn: 浓度
words.example: The concentration of salt is highest near the surface of the pond.
words.exampleCn: 池塘水里的盐在近水面处浓度最高。

words.cn: 相关
words.example: Higher scores correlated with more frequent practice.
words.exampleCn: 较高的分数与更频繁的练习相关。

words.cn: 密度
words.example: The survey covered areas of very different population density.
words.exampleCn: 调查覆盖了人口密度差异很大的地区。

words.cn: 耗尽
words.example: A second dry summer could deplete the village's reserves.
words.exampleCn: 再有一个干旱的夏季，村里的储备就可能耗尽。

words.cn: 偏差；偏离
words.example: A slight deviation from the planned route saved two hours.
words.exampleCn: 路线稍作调整就省了两个小时。

words.cn: 区分
words.example: The study differentiates seasonal jobs from permanent posts.
words.exampleCn: 该研究区分了季节性工作与长期岗位。

words.cn: 持续时间
words.example: The logger records the duration of each power cut.
words.exampleCn: 记录仪会记录每次断电的时长。

words.cn: 平衡状态
words.example: The sealed chamber eventually reached thermal equilibrium.
words.exampleCn: 密封舱最终达到了热平衡。

words.cn: 估算的
words.example: The estimated cost includes storage for the finished panels.
words.exampleCn: 估算费用包含成品板材的仓储费。

words.cn: 明确的
words.example: The handbook provides explicit instructions for recording absences.
words.exampleCn: 手册明确说明了如何记录缺勤。

words.cn: 坡度
words.example: The gradient becomes steeper beyond the gate.
words.exampleCn: 过了大门，坡度就变大了。

words.cn: 同质的；均匀的
words.example: Stir until the mixture is homogeneous.
words.exampleCn: 搅拌至混合物均匀。

words.cn: 发生率
words.example: The incidence of faults fell after the valves were replaced.
words.exampleCn: 更换阀门后，故障发生率下降了。

words.cn: 中位数
words.example: The median was lower than the mean because a few rents were very high.
words.exampleCn: 由于少数房租极高，中位数低于平均数。

words.cn: 迁徙
words.example: These birds migrate inland during the wet season.
words.exampleCn: 这些鸟在雨季迁往内陆。

words.cn: 常规；规范
words.example: Unpaid trial shifts soon became the norm in that district.
words.exampleCn: 无薪试工很快成了那个地区的常态。

words.cn: 抵消
words.example: Lower fuel use partly offset the higher maintenance costs.
words.exampleCn: 燃料用量减少，抵消了部分上涨的维护费用。

words.cn: 结果
words.example: Researchers tracked the outcome of each appeal.
words.exampleCn: 研究人员追踪了每项申诉的结果。

words.cn: 外围的；边缘的
words.example: Peripheral districts received fewer deliveries during the strike.
words.exampleCn: 罢工期间，外围地区收到的配送更少。

words.cn: 普遍的
words.example: The custom is most prevalent in villages along the estuary.
words.exampleCn: 这种习俗在河口沿岸的村庄最为普遍。

words.cn: 替代指标
words.example: The study used water bills as a proxy for household consumption.
words.exampleCn: 研究用水费账单作为家庭用水量的替代指标。

words.cn: 残余的
words.example: The lid kept residual heat inside the pot.
words.exampleCn: 盖子把余热留在了锅里。

words.cn: 稳定性
words.example: Wide feet improve the stability of the folding stand.
words.exampleCn: 较宽的支脚提高了折叠架的稳定性。

words.cn: 阈值
words.example: The alarm sounds when pressure rises above the threshold.
words.exampleCn: 压力超过阈值时警报会响起。

words.cn: 轨迹；发展路径
words.example: The long closure changed the trajectory of ticket sales.
words.exampleCn: 长时间停业改变了售票量的走势。

words.cn: 潜在的；深层的
words.example: The patch stopped the leak briefly but left the underlying crack untouched.
words.exampleCn: 补片暂时止住了漏水，但下面的裂缝仍在。

words.cn: 有效性
words.example: Missing responses may affect the validity of the comparison.
words.exampleCn: 缺失的答复可能影响比较的有效性。

name: 日常高频
description: 从早餐、通勤到出门办事，练习随时用得上的词。

words.cn: 下午
